title: Review worker asks before landing a loop's design change when merging is on
notes: When merging is on (autoMerge, ship-decision-1), reviewPrompt's land steps (src/main/ship/review.ts:144-156) run pr land once the loop has converged, and nothing checks whether a round changed what the card asked for. A #329-style swap of the card's rule then merges with nobody asked, the outcome #338 prevents only where main lands. Fix: stop before pr land on such a change and report it to main. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/339 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/338#discussion_r4627908449
